_comment: Where the generator's jaPRO data comes from. The bundled Docker configs are read from `docker_commit` with
git show, never copied by hand; bump the commit and rerun build.py to pick up changes. Item classnames and the
weapon and force-power enums are read from the reference's source_commit (_data/reference-meta.json).
`dropped` lists names the bundled configs set that the generator leaves out, each with the reason.
`settable` lists cvars the reference marks engine-managed that configs can in fact set, each with the reason.

dropped.disable_item_medpak: No item has the classname item_medpak, so this cvar does nothing (bg_misc.c item list).

settable.g_npcspskill: The reference counts it as engine-managed because it has CVAR_INTERNAL, but that flag only hides a cvar from listings and completion (cvar.cpp); configs can set it, and the bundled default.cfg and tribesbase.cfg do.
